reviews.title: Reliable, but limited power (less than stated)
reviews.comment: Pros: * Work well on Linux. * 48GB memory is convenient for many gen ai applications. * relatively quiet Cons: * Card is limited to 241 watt power at least on Linux, instead of advertised 295 watt (with latest vbios and everything else checked and confirmed).
reviews.author: V

reviews.title: Bottom Line: Check EVERY SINGLE specification and make sure you are getting what you paid for.
reviews.comment: Buyer beware. 1st card was already opened and described as "new". Second card decided to check my ROPs because of the 5090 fiasco. ROPs are fine, however the Memory Bus width is 192 instead of 384. This is the equivalent of have a W7900 with 24 Gig of memory with a 384 Bus Width. For a workstaion card where you are running professional applications this utterly destroys any advantage you had of a workstation GPU. Not good folks.
reviews.author: George Tatar Jr.
